label: digit 3 input in the first three original positions
explanation: Fires only when the input token is the digit 3 during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at positions t=0..2, and on a small fraction of 3s at t=3. Within that set it fires on almost every occurrence (precision 1.0 on dev). Magnitude falls off with position: largest at t=0 (about 1.76 max, 43% of mass), lower at t=1 (36%), lower still at t=2 (21%, most of the lowest-quartile examples), and weak and occasional at t=3. Never fires on any other token, on 3 at positions >= 4, on the delimiter step, or anywhere in the copy phase (even when 3 is input or output there).

issues: Only gap: about 1.9k missed steps on the test split, all of them a 3 at t=3 with weak activation (0.01-0.21 of max). They hold 0.3% of activation mass and only about 7% of the 3s at t=3 fire. The explanation already says this. Widening to t<=3 gives test precision 0.78, recall 1.0, F1 0.877, which matches the claim.

Test split: precision 1.0, 0 false positives, F1 0.981, mass recall 0.997. Dev profile: 0 activations in the delimiter or copy phase, on any token other than 3, or at t>=4. Mass share by t is 0.43 at t=0, 0.36 at t=1, 0.21 at t=2 and 0.004 at t=3. All of this matches the explanation.
